parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description: The language in which you want the results to be displayed. Valid values: zh-CN and en-US. Default value: zh-CN. The value zh-CN indicates Chinese, and the value en-US indicates English.

parameters.name: AuthRule
parameters.description: The content of the service authentication rule.

parameters.name: Enable
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable the rule.

parameters.name: K8sNamespace
parameters.description: The namespace ID of the Kubernetes cluster.

parameters.name: Source
parameters.description: The service source that the application accesses.
